text:
Sam: quick conv: we need a safer path for runtime flag applies that touches routing + quotas.
Yara: agreed. current flow is too "apply and pray" for large configs.
Diego: proposal: preview -> preflight (simulated apply) -> gated apply. each step emits telemetry.
Mina: what does preflight do that's different from preview?
Diego: preview is static diff + est impacts. preflight runs a sandboxed routing decision engine over a sampled traffic trace to detect SLO regressions and quota contention.
Sam: +1. preflight should also simulate autoscaler reactions to QPS changes.
Yara: UX: console shows Preview card (diff + simple metrics), Preflight results (pass/warn/fail) and Apply button (disabled when preflight fails).
Mina: override policy: self-serve force is disabled for >25% route impact. ops-only force with ticket required.
Sam: API shapes: POST /v1/configs/{id}/preview -> returns preview_id. POST /v1/configs/{id}/preflight {"preview_id":...} -> returns preflight_id + verdict. POST /v1/configs/{id}/apply {"preflight_id":... , "force":false}.
Diego: telemetry plan: counters: config_preview_total{bucket="small|medium|full"}, config_preflight_total{verdict="pass|warn|fail"}, config_apply_total{result="applied|blocked|forced"}. histogram config_apply_latency_seconds.
SRE: strong 👍 on avoiding raw ids as metric labels. use small hashes if needed and put ids only in logs/traces.
Yara: dashboard asks: show a small sparkline of SLO delta alongside each preview result, plus heatmap of affected routes.
Mina: add estimated quota delta (rps and token-cost) per route. engineers often miss cost impact.
Sam: guardrails: block if (p99_up > 1% && affected_routes_pct > 5%) OR (error_rate_up > 0.2% && affected_qps > 500).
Diego: and block if estimated token-cost delta > $0.05/minute at 99th percentile for that tenant class.
Yara: console should suggest safe cohorts based on preflight: e.g. [0.1%, 1%, 10%, 100%] with rationale (e.g. "10% recommended: affects 12 routes, est p99 delta 0.4%").
Sam: audit: every apply must create an audit event with initiator, preview_id, preflight_id, decision_reason, and trace_id.
Mina: sample log lines to standardize:
```
cfg_preview id=3b2f initiator=sam routes=42 est_cost_cents=34 preview_bucket=medium
cfg_preflight id=8c9a initiator=sam verdict=warn sample_trace=trace/abc123
cfg_apply id=ff12 initiator=sam result=blocked reason="p99_up_1.2%" preflight_id=8c9a
```
Diego: preflight storage: keep results + sampled traces for 14 days. previews can be 7 days by default. longer retention via archive flag.
SRE: watch cardinality of route-level metrics. prefer aggregate counts + top-N lists emitted to logs. Grafana can surface top-N via logs/ES.
Yara: UX tweak: when blocked, we show a CTA "Request ops review" that creates a ticket prefilled with preview+preflight links.
Sam: ops-bot: create ticket CFG-RUN-204 with owners @Mina and @SRE for implementation + runbook.
ops-bot: created ticket CFG-RUN-204 assigned to @Mina, @SRE https://tickets/redwood/CFG-RUN-204
Diego: preflight sampling: run sim on 1% of recent traffic (time-window configurable). include both prefix-cache cold/warm runs.
Mina: add a dry-warm mode: preflight with do_warm=true that issues cache-warm requests but doesn't alter routing. useful for model-variant swaps.
Sam: metrics detail: config_preflight_sampled_traces_total gauge and config_preflight_warn_reasons (comma list) in logs.
SRE: avoid multi-label arrays in metrics. log warn reasons as structured logs. metrics stay simple.
Yara: design-bot: I'll drop a quick console wire with the three-step flow and the blocked CTA by EOD.
design-bot: posted mock at https://design/redwood/config-preflight-mock :art: 
Mina: backlog & timeline: Diego will implement preview API + estimator this sprint, Mina will build preflight sandbox next sprint, SRE will review metric schema.
Sam: final question: should we allow apply to reference a previous successful preflight (like reuse preflight_id) for repeated applies?
Diego: yes but only within TTL (default 1h). otherwise preflight must be rerun. prevents stale sims.
SRE: +1 on TTL; also rate-limit preflight runs per config to avoid DoS.
Sam: ok — next steps captured in CFG-RUN-204. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
